title: Haile Selassie returns to Addis Ababa
summary: Emperor Haile Selassie re-entered his capital five years to the day after Italian troops had occupied it, escorted by Ethiopian patriots and British and African forces.
reason: British Commonwealth troops and Ethiopian resistance fighters had driven the Italians out of most of Ethiopia in the East African campaign.
significance: Ethiopia became the first country occupied by the Axis to be liberated, and it regained its independence.
